tested_controls.description: State-changing POST/PATCH/DELETE require valid matching X-CSRF-Token header.
Synthetic demo accounts strictly return HTTP 403 in production environment.
Support role strictly blocked from patient PHR, clinical notes, and OCR transcripts.
SHA-256 HMAC signature and replay window strictly enforced on webhooks (13/13 passed).
Argon2id with constant-time verification and dummy timing equalizer.
X-Forwarded-For sanitized; audit logs mask client IPs to /24 subnet.
